name: io.github.noahowsh/birdieapi
title: BirdieAPI
description: PGA Tour data from 2001: leaderboards, holes, courses, ratings, par-3/4/5 splits, major winner odds.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: Your BirdieAPI API key. Get a free key with 500 credits at birdieapi.com/signup

tools.name: list_tournaments
tools.description: A season's tournaments with dates, winner, purse and courses

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Tournaments this week and coming up, with the host course

tools.name: get_leaderboard
tools.description: A tournament's full leaderboard: position, rounds, total, earnings and points

tools.name: get_scorecard
tools.description: A player's hole-by-hole scorecard for a tournament, with par and yardage

tools.name: get_course
tools.description: A course as set up for a tournament: par and yards per hole and how each hole played

tools.name: get_ratings
tools.description: Our strokes-versus-field rating: every active player, field-strength adjusted

tools.name: get_player
tools.description: Profile, rating, season lines and recent finishes

tools.name: get_player_results
tools.description: A player's tournaments and rounds by season, with strokes versus the field

tools.name: get_player_stats
tools.description: A player's season stats: scoring, birdies, par-3/4/5 scoring, driving, greens, putting

tools.name: get_course_history
tools.description: A player's record at one tournament or course, every year

tools.name: get_head_to_head
tools.description: Two players' finishes and rounds in every tournament they both played

tools.name: get_leaders
tools.description: Season leaders for any stat we compute or ESPN keeps

tools.name: get_winner_odds
tools.description: The four majors' winner prices by sportsbook before the first round: opening and latest, with implied probability
